scope: One shared original3warmup prefix, then four COW-cloned native Rust children each complete the unchanged20 measured fixed-fixture battles. Same pinned Node full report checks all non-timing fields and complete host-tape consumption. Parallel fixed-fixture throughput is not full-scene random5v5 or20k-battle qualification.

limits.memoryScope: Parent+four-child PSS plus orchestrator RSS; summed RSS separately overcounts shared COW pages.
limits.cgroupSafetyScope: Whole current cgroup estimated working memory, excluding only clean reclaimable file cache; default stop threshold95% of memory.max. Raw memory.current retained. PSS independently bounded.

gc.scope: Each child inherits the original warmup collection count and cadence position, then completes all20 measured source battles.

observer.scope: Orchestrator process CPU only during the native fork run; includes PSS/RSS/cgroup reads, not child CPU or prior hashing/linking.

cgroup.scope: Whole cgroup includes workers, observer and any unrelated concurrent processes; counters cannot identify a specific overhead source.

cgroupMemory.estimate: max(0, memory.current - max(0, file - shmem - file_dirty - file_writeback)); subtraction is clamped to memory.current
cgroupMemory.scope: Whole cgroup. Guard retains anonymous/shared/dirty/writeback memory and excludes estimated clean reclaimable file cache; raw memory.current is always reported. Independently enforced while PSS polls are sparse.

aggregate.method: 80 measured battles / (latest measured end - earliest measured start), using a common SystemTime UNIX epoch; never sum per-process rates.

provenance.rlibSelectionPolicy: Newest mtime per top-level crate in completed frozen release target; all rlibs frozen pre/post. This tool links the standalone driver but does not rebuild/reprove source-to-rlib compilation.
